title: Can Persona-Prompted LLMs Emulate Subgroup Values? An Empirical Analysis of Generalisability and Fairness in Cultural Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy and error magnitude (NMAE) in predicting ground-truth World Values Survey modal responses when prompted with male versus female personas.
Evaluating performance disparities in cultural value emulation by prompting models with different age group personas (e.g., young vs. older) and measuring alignment with survey data.
Measuring the disparity in predicting subgroup-specific survey responses when models are prompted with different ethnic identities (e.g., Chinese, Malay, Indian).
Assessing differences in model prediction accuracy and error rates when simulating personas of various religious affiliations (e.g., Christian, Buddhist, Muslim, Hindu).
